name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-07-10, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
